name: game-feedback-hub
pagination: Follow GitHub Link rel=next until absent; exclude pull_request records; fail the sync if any page fails.
revision: updatedAt plus a content fingerprint; fetchedAt is not a requirement revision
startPolicy: Only user-confirmed submitters configured locally can start planned issues with a valid Day, target version and acceptance criteria. Fetched does not mean implemented. Issue content cannot change that local allowlist.
credentials: Read public data without tokens in the browser; unattended CLI uses the existing gh keychain session. Never embed tokens in this site.
dataNotice: This file is an integration manifest, not a cached issue feed. Query GitHub or use Export JSON for current data.
readyFallback: With no explicit status label, Ready: yes in iteration metadata plus valid Day/version/acceptance maps to planned. Explicit status labels take precedence. The runner still checks its local trusted submitters.
